configuration: Official IFrame API with youtube-nocookie.com, autoplay off, ephemeral WKWebView, local versioned opt-in before player creation, settings withdrawal, no Google login/IDFA/native ad SDK
collection_basis: Google documents receiving technical request data and retaining server logs. Privacy-enhanced mode limits personalization, not all collection. Apple includes embedded WebView collection.
not_collected_by_native_app: Workout history, repetitions and weights: stored on device
Contact list, photos, microphone, precise location: no native access in source

category_review.basis: YouTube documents playback data; Google partner-sites notice covers embedded YouTube and measurement, including contextual video activity. Policy permits cross-service measurement; privacy-enhanced mode does not expressly exclude it.

YouTube embedded-player ads retain creator ad settings. Google documents ad impressions/interactions, measurement and invalid-impression detection. Conservative inclusion covers ads when served, not a claim all catalog videos show ads.
Google documents signed-out browser/app/device identifiers. This covers third-party browser identifiers, not native IDFA access. Temporary storage does not establish anonymization before collection.
Google partner-sites notice expressly includes YouTube embeds and use of IP for general location, advertising measurement and service purposes. No GPS/precise-location collection is asserted.

Technical request/browser/device logs used for service reliability, troubleshooting and fraud/abuse. No advertising purpose assigned to this diagnostic-only category; revisit if evidence shows such reuse.

att: Build 1.0 (2) includes ATTrackingManager and a five-language NSUserTrackingUsageDescription. Embedded playback requires system authorization and versioned local consent. Denial or restriction keeps the player disabled while exercises, workouts and external YouTube links remain available. This implementation and simulator tests do not establish a complete provider data inventory or current physical-device playback.
publication_blockers: Provider-specific retained data, purposes, linkage and advertising measurement behavior not fully documented
Owner reports YouTube tested on iPhone 15 Pro, iOS 26; exact build and per-video playback evidence remain unconfirmed
Google embed guidance limits privacy-enhanced mode to websites; public policy assurances for the iOS WebView need verification or correction
Made for Kids status has not been checked for each embedded video
